name: llm-anthropic
notes: CI (test.yml, matrix 3.10-3.14) runs `uv run pytest` (dev dependency-group). The recipe installs `-e $SRC --group dev` into the venv. 32 vcr tests replay from tests/cassettes with pytest-recording's default record_mode=none. No real key is needed: the tests fall back to a dummy key when PYTEST_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset. Nothing deselected. The 9 warnings are pytest-asyncio/deprecation warnings and harmless. I didn't run `cog --check README.md`. Resolved anthropic==1.13.0 and llm==0.36 from PyPI, not the local llm checkout. Common: setup runs from the router-migrate root (each step sources scripts/env.sh so uv caches/Pythons stay in .tools); --exclude-newer 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z pins dependency resolution to the baseline date. test_cmd sandboxes HOME and TMPDIR into $ENV/home and $ENV/tmp so tests never read or write the real ~ (e.g. ~/.config) or /tmp. Baseline was taken with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed), so the tests are confirmed offline. Rebuilt from scratch into a second env (<name>-check): identical uv pip freeze and identical counts. Check-run counts: 123 passed, 9 warnings in 2.61s (3.6s).
